name: v1.17.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Added

* Support starred Jira filters in JQL editor by @cullenstone1 in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/375
* Add config setting `search_results_columns` to allow users to define the columns to display in the search results by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/374
* Add support for the Atlassian Team custom field in Jira Cloud by @dvaske in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/376

### Minor Changes

* Bump `multidict` to v6.9.1 by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/379
* Use `self.app.config` in JQL editor module by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/380

### Documentation

* Update in-app help with details about using starred JQL filters by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/381

## New Contributors
* @dvaske made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/376

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/compare/v1.16.0...v1.17.0
